parameters.name: AvailableSpace
parameters.description:
The active space of the device. Unit: KB. The value can be any positive number.
> The **AvailableSpaceScope** parameter must be specified at the same time for this parameter to take effect.

parameters.name: AvailableSpaceScope
parameters.description:
The query condition for the free space of the device.

- **greater**: greater than.
- **smaller**: less than.
- **equal**: equal to.

Example: If **AvailableSpace** is set to **500** and **AvailableSpaceScope** is set to **smaller**, the list of devices whose free space is less than 500 KB is returned.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The query condition for the device name. Left-prefix matching is used.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view the instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProjectCode
parameters.description: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).
